desc:
🥷 Become the Ultimate Ninja! Train your shadow clones, defeat powerful enemies, and unlock legendary Ninjas as you grow stronger!

🖱️ Click to gain +1 Power!
💥 More Power = Stronger Attacks!
🥷 Unlock new Ninjas and build your shadow army!
⚔️ Defeat enemies to unlock new worlds!
🏆 Earn Wins and climb the leaderboards!
🥚 Hatch pets for powerful boosts!
🔄 Rebirth to reach new levels of ninja power!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support!
